assertions.name: borel_sum_singlevalued_smooth
assertions.source: Borel-Pade resummed Im V=0.0555 stable vs truncation; singularity off imaginary ray => no Stokes, exact smooth, no anchor-dependent transseries

description: Borel–Padé resummation of the divergent 4₁ Ohtsuki κ-tower to the exact smooth Im 𝔙, with literature Stokes/action cross-check. (1) Large-order ratio gives action A=Vol(4₁)/π=0.646 (geometric↔conjugate saddle gap, Garoufalidis–Gu–Mariño). (2) Borel–Padé[3/3] + Laplace at the imaginary substrate x=i·t gives resummed Im 𝔙_b=0.05545 (stable vs κ₁..κ₄ truncation 0.05481). (3) DECISIVE: the Borel singularity at real ξ=A is OFF the imaginary integration ray, so the Borel sum is single-valued — no Stokes median split, no e^{−A/x} trans-series on the imaginary ray. So resurgence delivers the exact smooth Im 𝔙 + the action, but NO anchor-dependent piece: the odd-S sign-flip is the 1/u³ ladder representation (merged #3636), representational/experimental-Q_β-limited, not a resummable physical effect. Caveat: only κ₁..κ₆ (exact 1..4 from #3628); 6 terms is few for Padé. Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no fit.
